# source: conformance/scenarios/unicode.txt

scenario unicode/bmp-literal
kind normative
spec Patterns are compared byte for byte, so non-ASCII characters match themselves.
file .gitignore
| café
| 日本語/
| ü*
path café => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:café
path cafe => NONE
path dir/café => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:café
path 日本語/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:日本語/
path 日本語 => NONE
path über => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:ü*
path uber => NONE

scenario unicode/wildcards-match-whole-characters
kind git-quirk
spec A question mark matches any one character except a slash.
note Git compares bytes, so a question mark matches a single byte and not a whole non-ASCII character.
file .gitignore
| caf?
| a?b
| a??b
path café => NONE
path cafe => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:caf?
path aéb => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:a??b
path aééb => NONE
path a世b => NONE
path a世世b => NONE

scenario unicode/bracket-with-non-ascii
kind git-quirk
spec A bracket expression matches one of the listed characters.
note Git compares bytes, so a non-ASCII member of a bracket expression is a set of bytes.
file .gitignore
| a[éè]
| b[^x]
path aé => NONE
path aè => NONE
path ae => NONE
path bé => NONE
path bx => NONE

scenario unicode/outside-bmp
kind normative
spec Patterns are compared byte for byte, so characters outside the basic multilingual plane match themselves.
file .gitignore
| 😀.txt
| dir𝄞/
| *🚀
path 😀.txt => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:😀.txt
path 😁.txt => NONE
path dir𝄞/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:dir𝄞/
path dir𝄞 => NONE
path x🚀 => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:*🚀
path x🚁 => NONE
path a/b🚀 => IGNORED # .gitignore:3:*🚀

scenario unicode/outside-bmp-question-mark
kind git-quirk
spec A question mark matches any one character except a slash.
note Git compares bytes, so one question mark does not match a four byte character and four of them do.
file .gitignore
| a?b
| c????d
path a😀b => NONE
path c😀d => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:c????d

scenario unicode/composed-and-decomposed-differ
kind normative
spec Patterns are compared byte for byte, so a composed character does not match its decomposed form.
file .gitignore
| café
| nai`u0308ve
path café => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:café
path cafe`u0301 => NONE
path nai`u0308ve => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:nai`u0308ve
path naïve => NONE

scenario unicode/decomposed-pattern
kind normative
spec Patterns are compared byte for byte, so a decomposed character does not match its composed form.
file .gitignore
| cafe`u0301
path cafe`u0301 => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:cafe`u0301
path café => NONE

scenario unicode/precomposeunicode-enabled
kind platform
spec Unicode normalization is not part of gitignore(5).
note core.precomposeunicode only affects how Git reads names from some filesystems and does not change how a pattern is compared.
config core.precomposeunicode=true
file .gitignore
| café
path café => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:café
path cafe`u0301 => NONE

scenario unicode/combining-mark-as-wildcard-target
kind git-quirk
spec An asterisk matches anything except a slash.
file .gitignore
| a*
path ae`u0301 => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:a*
path a`u0301 => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:a*
path a => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:a*

scenario unicode/zero-width-and-control-characters
kind normative
spec Patterns are compared byte for byte.
file .gitignore
| a`u200Bb
| c`u00A0d
path a`u200Bb => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:a`u200Bb
path ab => NONE
path c`u00A0d => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:c`u00A0d
path c`sd => NONE

scenario unicode/non-ascii-in-directory-names
kind normative
spec Directory patterns follow the same rules for any characters.
file .gitignore
| été/
| /док/*.md
path été/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:été/
path a/été/ => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:été/
path été/file => IGNORED # .gitignore:1:été/
path док/a.md => IGNORED # .gitignore:2:/док/*.md
path док/b/a.md => NONE

scenario unicode/non-ascii-ignore-file-path
kind normative
spec Patterns in a nested ignore file are relative to its directory, whatever the directory name.
file été/.gitignore
| secret
path été/secret => IGNORED # été/.gitignore:1:secret
path secret => NONE
path ete`u0301/secret => NONE
